verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows React rendering into a browser DOM node (createRoot, hydrateRoot) and being added to existing HTML pages. That is React mounting into the DOM, not developers directly manipulating DOM nodes from components to drive third-party charting or visualization libraries. Nothing in the pack documents refs, effect-based DOM access, or integrating imperative browser libraries, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can directly manipulate the DOM to integrate existing browser libraries like charting or visualization tools
